title: Unravelling the role of key amino acid residues of the parainfluenza fusion peptide in membrane fusion
content:

Mariana Valério, Carolina C. Buga, Diogo A. Mendonça, Miguel A. R. B. Castanho, Manuel N. Melo, Cláudio M. Soares, Diana Lousa, Ana Salomé Veiga
Parainfluenza viruses entry relies on membrane fusion promoted by the fusion peptide - PIFP. F103A and Q120A substitutions impair the PIFP fusogenic properties, revealing key amino acid residues for its function.
